purpose: Dated research pointers distinguish documentary evidence, forecasts, unresolved questions, and deliberate fiction. Not a comprehensive literature review.

items.description: A peer-reviewed study reports cultured neural networks interacting with simulated Pong and changing performance under structured feedback. Its methods do not demonstrate a full human mind uploaded to a computer.
NUS Medicine reports an August 2026 biological-computing prototype containing 20 CL1 units. This is a research prototype, not proof of conscious brain hosting.
ASRM states that polygenic embryo screening is not ready for clinical use; this cannot be described as reliably engineering perfect children.
The IEA projects around 945 TWh of worldwide data-center electricity demand for 2030 in a base case. This is a forecast, not a measured 2030 value.
The year 2084's enhanced class, neural subscriptions, corporate immortality products, characters, and plot are original fiction, not established future events.
Scientific research has not established that cultured neurons responding to digital feedback have a human-like conscious experience or are complete minds inside a game.
